page.layout: One block of running text in one column, with no marginal notes. The catchword "sociis" stands alone at the lower right, below the last line.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: His verò periculis nil validius opponi posse omnes existimabant, quàm cum ci-vitate hac nostrâ fœdus. Eo fœdere pro-misit civitas, fidam se sociam fœderatis, om-nibusq; Frisiis liberis futuram, societati huic fortunas & corpora, si posseret res, impensu-ram; libertatem suam & fœderatorum contra vim peregrinorum Principum quorumvis, & factiosæ Nobilitatis pro viribus defensuram: si qua clades sociis accideret in prælio, iis periculo perculsis & receptum quærentibus, portas se suas aperturam: factiosos in Hu-nesgouiâ & Fivelgoniâ huic fœderi cbni-tentes, & concordiam distinentes, ne Reip. malo sint, compressuram. Idem fœdus an-no proximo M. CCC. LXXXII. repetitum solenniter, & amplius quoque factum, asscriptis omnibus, qui inter Lavicam & Amasum colunt, cum conditione tem-poris in septennium, atque ita è curiâ ur-bis præconis voce in magnâ hominum frequentiâ publicatum. Itemque anno sequente iteratum similiter. Et cùm tri-ennio post rursus se factiones in agro vi-cino moverent violentius, ac turbas cæ-desque cierent, autoresque à civitate & sociis

page.notes: The word "cbnitentes" is printed as "cbni-tentes" at the line end; it is probably a printing error for "obnitentes", left as printed. The spelling "posseret" and "distinentes" are kept as printed. The catchword "sociis" is set with a long s, and the running head is in small capitals. The italic passage runs from "fidam" to "compressuram." and is marked with <i>. The woodcut or engraving is not present on this page.
